d1064.Raw_Article: 1064 Kui ōpu inba to be warm weather, be sultry or stifling. Kur. ōrnā to be warm weather, be heated (e.g. iron, body with fever); ōrta'ānā to warm, heat. Malt. órtre to make red-hot; óthre to become red-hot. Cf. 656 Ta. uru. DED(S) 898.
